title: Holidays Act
verified_how: Fetched the index page: title 'Holidays Act', citation (R.S.C., 1985, c. H-5), current to 2026-07-21, last amended 2018-03-01.
notes: Declares Canada Day, Victoria Day and Remembrance Day as legal holidays. Holiday-pay entitlements come from the Canada Labour Code or provincial law. This is a supporting Act, not a principal one.
